piece.headline: RAVIN TAKES TOP SPOT WHILE HAALAND LEAVES 21 CAPTAINS EMPTY-HANDED
piece.standfirst: Ravin backed N.Jackson while 21 managers backed Haaland, and now he shares top spot with Nikhil on 650.
piece.big_picture: Ravin was the only manager to captain N.Jackson. It lifted him from 5th to joint first, level with Nikhil on 650. Haaland blanked for 21 captains. The title race is now a straight shootout with nothing between them.
piece.decision_of_the_week: Poonam brought in Manzambi, Van Hecke, Evanilson and Kudus. The swap was worth 34 points and lifted her 6 places. Bold, busy and exactly right.
piece.one_to_watch: Nikhil and Ravin are level at the top with no gap. If either picks the wrong captain next week, the other could run off with it. Nothing else matters yet.

winners.name: Ravin
winners.verdict: Captained N.Jackson alone, got 18 from the armband, and played his Free Hit. That was nerve, and it paid off.

winners.name: Poonam
winners.verdict: 4 fresh faces in, and the swap alone was worth 34 points. Bench pain didn't dent it. That's proper recruitment.

winners.name: Hishaan
winners.verdict: Brought in Tavernier and N.Jackson and climbed to 21st. A small climb, but the swap worked.

losers.name: Alia
losers.verdict: 3 new signings, no payback. Alia will want this week wiped from the record.
